verdicts.why: The check detects that repeating an ArtifactPointer publish after removing its type is refused at stage 4 as an unknown artifact type, writes nothing, and preserves the original pointer. It does not assert the stated request-id uniqueness invariant for Room and ArtifactPointer records, nor the repeat behavior for Room.
